title: Analytics: block HotJar when PII is detected just like all the other 3rd party scripts
body:
We currently block third party tracking when potential PII (personally identifiable information) is detected on the URL. We need to do the same for HotJar.

Reference:
- `isPiiUrl()`: https://github.com/Automattic/wp-calypso/search?utf8=%E2%9C%93&q=isPiiUrl&type=
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
